name: Barbarian audit: Bloody Onslaught spell modifier reaches its target spells (#1087)
contract: Audit report #1087 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 801758 has no modifier for op 1
707583 op 1 flat +6000 reaches 801758 (mask selects 1 Barbarian spell(s))
